info.name: Address Validation 5103 Waiver Permanent And Total Disability API
Get information about a Veteran's P&T disability and IU disability statuses and effective dates.

items.docs: This endpoint provides a Veteran's permanent and total (P&T) disability and total disability based on Individual Unemployability (IU) statuses and effective dates, based on the ID in the bearer token.

info.name: Search for information about a Veteran's P&T disability and IU disability statuses and effective dates, based on demographic data.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a Veteran's information about permanent and total (P&T) disability and total disability based on Individual Unemployability (IU) statuses and effective dates.

  Required information:

  * First name
  * Last name
  * Date of birth
  * Street address
  * City
  * State
  * Country
  * ZIP code

  Optional information:

  * Middle name
  * Gender
  * Mother's maiden name
  * Home phone number
  * Birthplace city
  * Birthplace state
  * Birthplace country

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a Veteran's information about permanent and total (P&T) disability and total disability based on Individual Unemployability (IU) statuses and effective dates. It allows searching for a Veteran using a Social Security number and demographic information.

 * Social Security number
